name: GPT-Neo
description:
Here is how to read the GPT-Neo config.json. The architecture class is GPTNeoForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 2,560: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 50,257 × 2,560: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 20, so each head sees 128 dimensions (2,560 / 20). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 2560 / 20 = 128. 128 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_hidden_layers is 32: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

max_position_embeddings is 2,048 tokens — the context window in the config. There is no rope_scaling entry, so the rotary positions are used as-is.

vocab_size is 50,257. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/EleutherAI/gpt-neo-2.7B/blob/main/config.json.
